items.prompt: To rewrite an improper fraction as a mixed number, first we turn this into a division calculation:  19/5
Our fraction had five on the bottom. Draw that here, above and to the right of the division.
items.demo: *5* on the bottom, above and to the right of the division.

items.prompt: If our fraction had had a seven on the bottom instead:  19/7  Then first we would turn that into a division problem.

items.demo: *7* on the bottom, above and to the right of the division.

items.prompt: And if our fraction looked like this:  219/73  Then first we would turn that into a division problem.
